entities.summary: Albert Kindler was a German genre painter in the late Romantic style; associated with the Düsseldorfer Malerschule. Albert Kindler was a painters & sculptors from Allensbach (1833, Allensbach–1876-04-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
